claim.source: LIQD Blackjack: the game page liqd.com/originals/blackjack shows "Released: June 2026 | Edge: 0.48%" = RTP 99.52 %, the figure held here, and its structured data gives RTP 99.52% (read 2026-10-01, evidence/rtp-page-labels-2026-10-01.json; first seen as "Edge: 0.48%" on the game surface, E16; src/config.ts STOREFRONT_EDGE). The same page also shows "RTP (optimal play) 99.51%" and "House Edge 0.49%". The config label houseEdge 1% (LIQD's game-settings response, E23; src/config.ts NOMINAL_HOUSE_EDGE) is a second, lower figure (RTP 99 %); RTP-CLAIM 1.2.0 counts a stated edge in the game settings as published, and a setting within the band of 99.52 % is also above 99 % less the band, so holding 99.52 % covers it
